inventory.name: Resonant Orb
inventory.description:
✦ ✦ ✦ ✦ ✦ ✦

The orb sings. Not loudly — completely. Every bond in your ledger is in the note, and the note is in tune.

Grade: Crescendo — 4 front / 4 bench
The orb is whole, and it sings.

inventory.description: A resonance blank from Archivist Voss — a sphere of clouded glass, fallen apart. It records your ledger as you grow, and comes together as your household does.
